title: GATEWAY
body:
Please have your keycard, your papers and your
remaining dignity ready for inspection. The way into the
inner city is a checkpoint: three walls, three locked
doors, and a Warden on patrol who will call the guards the
moment you look suspicious. You look suspicious. Wardens
carry keycards -- they won't need them where they're going.
Missile Batteries can't be reached, only reasoned with.
Reason with them loudly.

captions.text: Calls the guards. Has your keys.
Seekers. Stun it, then shoot it.
